request: Create a 40-minute lesson on what can be determined without matching attendance lists. Ask for the number attending either event and both events, an explicit allocation, and a response to the claim that unmatched names always prevent exact answers.
objective: Use full population coverage in one event to derive exact overlap and union despite missing cross-list matching.

sources.text: Fictional residents association ledger: there were sixty registered members throughout the two-event weekend; the register did not change, and both events admitted only registered members.
The annual briefing recorded sixty distinct members. The repair workshop recorded twenty-two distinct members. Each list counted each member at most once.
The two lists have not been matched by identity. Attendance records do not record opinions about either event.
